name: Randou Natsumi
source:
A mathematics teacher at Himeshiro Girls' Academy and an alumnus of the academy who always wears revealing clothes. Before graduating, she was also a member of the Six Maidens. In contrast to her showy appearance, Natsumi is a kind and friendly woman who is particularly popular with the male teachers.

She is also a heavy drinker as well as a ruthless sadist who loves making both men and women submit to her.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1292095]Getchu[/url]]
